one_liner: LaMelo Ball scores 26.9 points per 36 minutes on 41.1 percent shooting -- the lowest field-goal percentage of any high-usage scorer in this set.
three_things: 26.9 points and 8.8 assists per 36: enormous offensive responsibility.
41.1 percent from the field is the cost attached to it.
Availability compounds the question: 135 games across the window.
context_note: Per-36-minute rates over a 3-season sample (seasons_played: 3), not per-game and not full-career figures. The manifest is descriptive_only: no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty, and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor applies. Games and minutes measure availability, not how well those minutes were used. The comparison is scoped to the players with insight files in this set; nothing here adjusts for shot difficulty or supporting cast.
